description: This file defines a TaskRunner class for managing and executing asynchronous tasks with setup and teardown phases, including timeout and signal handling, within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TaskRunner
classes.description: Manages a list of tasks with setup and teardown phases, handles execution flow, errors, timeouts, and interruptions.

classes.name: TimeoutWatcher
classes.description: Watches for timeout expiration during task execution, can be disarmed.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the task list.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs all tasks with cleanup, returns overall status.

methods.name: runDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, handles interruptions, timeouts, and errors.
